"},{"order":12,"type":"subheading","text":"Best Practices for Navigation Design"},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Always include proper ARIA attributes (like aria-current and aria-expanded) for screen readers and accessibility compliance."},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use appropriate breakpoint classes (e.g., navbar-expand-lg) to control when your navigation collapses into a mobile menu."},{"order":15,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Keep link text concise and meaningful so users immediately understand the destination."}]
